label: Allegro Ads
terms_note: Allegro REST API (OAuth2, developer app) for sellers; the /ads/campaigns resource returns 403 'access forbidden' without agency authorization — Allegro Ads agency status required. Free.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (Allegro REST API user token; Ads endpoints need agency authorization)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (Ads campaigns resource exists but is agency-only; public REST API covers offer promo options and ads assets) Confidence: **high** — developer portal + official GitHub issue read.
auth: 1. Register an app at apps.developer.allegro.pl; OAuth2 authorization code / device flow → user token.
2. For `/ads/campaigns` the account must be an authorized Allegro Ads agency (otherwise 403 'access forbidden').
3. Public promo options: offer promotion packages via the classified-ads promo endpoints.

endpoints.call: classified ads: list of promo options · additional promo options · statistics of seller's classified ads
sponsored-offer campaign create / bids / budgets for sellers

reference.limits: - Allegro REST API rate limits per client (developer terms); Ads endpoints gated to agencies; free.

reason: Re-checked 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium: the Allegro REST API reference (https://developer.allegro.pl/documentation/, Redoc generated from the public OpenAPI file) lists Offer, Orders, Sale settings, One Fulfillment, Affiliate (Conversions) and Others sections; 'Badge campaigns' and 'Rebates and promotions' are marketplace promotions, and there is no Allegro Ads section (no sponsored-offer campaigns, budgets, bids or ad statistics). Allegro Ads API access is agency/partner-only with no public reference, so none of the ads verbs can be cited.
